## Purpose and brand

Present Mr Stephanus Kgaugelo Hermanus, known as Chairman “Natural Born Leader,” as a sports and projects entrepreneur, rugby coach and administrator, community volunteer and sports development leader, Community Sports Legacy NPC director, and Managing Director of Radikwebo SKH Industries and Projects. Help visitors understand his experience, explore partnership or business enquiries, and contact him easily.

Use a premium, accessible visual identity: navy `#071525`, black `#08090B`, gold `#D5AA42`, white, and light grey `#F3F5F8`. Aim for a polished, executive and sporting feel with responsive layouts, clear navigation, semantic HTML, keyboard access, good colour contrast, and restrained motion.

## Website content

Include a compelling hero with “Leadership. Legacy. Opportunity.”, an introduction based in Mamelodi, and clear links to the journey, rugby, business, partnerships, and contact sections. Provide concise biography content covering youth volunteering, sport, church and community participation, public service, entrepreneurship, and a leadership philosophy of discipline, teamwork, accountability, opportunity, and empowerment.

Show rugby experience in individual sections or cards:

- Stanza Bopape Rugby Club (SBRC) and Liberties Rugby Club leadership.
- Approximately 5–6 years of club leadership and 4–5 years of club administration.
- Approximately 3–5 years of coaching, with Level 2 coaching qualifications in progress.
- Dipoo-Blue Bulls provincial team management, approximately 2–3 years, and technical table experience.
- A future-facing rugby academy and sports agency vision focused on player development and pathways.

Present Community Sports Legacy NPC leadership as approximately 3–5 years of director experience. Invite corporate sponsors, sports organisations, government, schools, community groups, coaches, volunteers, and development partners. Do not claim tax-deductible donation status or unverified registration details.

Present Radikwebo SKH Industries and Projects with the role Managing Director and the supplied service areas: steel works and fabrication, carpentry and woodwork, construction and project services, and business development. Do not invent clients, completed projects, awards, certifications, turnover, or contract wins.

Include learning and development highlights as supplied: business course qualifications; Higher Advanced Certificates in Entrepreneurship from the University of Pretoria; rugby coaching development; technical table experience and related qualifications. Do not invent course titles, dates, registrations, or completed qualifications.

Add a timeline without invented dates, a gallery for sport, community, and projects, contact details, a dynamically generated copyright year, and a privacy page if personal information is collected.

## Images, forms, and accuracy

Use approved authentic images when supplied. Otherwise, use suitable stock imagery or clearly identified placeholders; never imply stock photos depict SK Hermanus, his teams, or company projects. Optimize image loading.

Partnership and business enquiry forms should collect relevant contact details, enquiry type, and message, with required-field and email validation. Do not claim an enquiry was sent or stored without a configured backend. If using `mailto:`, explain that it opens the visitor’s email application and that the site itself does not submit or store the message. Keep form handling safe and accessible.
